scoring_justification: The orientation angle cannot be recomputed from raw artifacts because the simulation is the agent's job; compare reported angle to hidden threshold derived from the paper's perpendicular-alignment claim.

hidden_assets.generation_method: Set threshold 80° based on the paper's observed perpendicular orientation; angles >= 80° indicate perpendicular alignment.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This threshold reflects the paper's physical result; the reference solution writes 90°.

outputs.description: Average orientation angle of the simulated cylindrical domains relative to the cylinder long axis. The checker compares this to a hidden threshold based on the expected physical behavior.

output_contract.notes: The geometry parameters (cylinder dimensions, cross-section shape, mesh resolution) and numerical solver settings are left to the agent's discretion; the result must reflect the physics captured by the given free-energy parameters and periodic boundary conditions.

steps.comparison: >= threshold gives full reward, else proportional reward (max(0, value/threshold))
steps.description: Score reported average_orientation against hidden threshold
